option_relations.rationale: Paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block is a broader term that can encompass vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block
Vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block (VP-AVB) is directly mentioned in the leaf labels
Neurally mediated (vasovagal) syncope is a distinct condition, although it may share some similarities with vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block
Carotid sinus hypersensitivity is a different condition that may cause syncope, but it is not directly related to the leaf labels
